# Kolkata Startup Map

Kolkata Startup Map is an interactive directory of startups, companies, locations and hiring opportunities across Kolkata and the surrounding startup ecosystem.

## Main resource
- https://heysiddhartha.github.io/kolkata-startup-map/

## What the site contains
- Kolkata startup profiles
- Startup locations and sectors
- Hiring and job signals
- Startup discovery and ecosystem filters
